1	# RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	RedRoom Fitness is the original high-intensity interval training experience, combining treadmill running and strength training in a signature red-lit studio environment. Founded for those who demand more from their workout, RedRoom delivers results through science-backed HIIT methodology across global studio locations and a digital on-demand platform. The tone is bold, dark, and unapologetically intense.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: `#FF0000` (RedRoom Red — primary), `#141414` (Charcoal Black — background), `#FFFFFF` (White — text/accent)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: "TRY THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD™"
    10	Subtitle: "Buy an exclusive first-timer 3-pack and receive a FREE Fuel Shake or Grab + Go item after your third class."
    11	CTA: "BUY NOW" | "BOOK CLASSES"
    12	
    13	## Top Bar Promo
    14	Text: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
    15	CTA: "Learn More" → links to Digital Platform page
    16	
    17	## Community Promo
    18	Heading: "Join the Hustle"
    19	Body: "Welcome to RedRoom. More than a workout — it's a movement. Our global community of athletes, first-timers, and everyone in between push limits together in the Red Room. Show up. Work hard. Earn your place."
    20	CTA: "Explore the Community"
    21	
    22	## Two Ways to Red Room
    23	Heading: "TWO WAYS TO RED ROOM"
    24	Option 1: **In-Studio** — "Get a (Red) Room. Step inside our signature red-lit studios for the full immersive experience. Heart-pounding music, elite instructors, and the energy of the pack."
    25	Option 2: **Digital** — "Go Digital. Stream world-class workouts from anywhere. Same intensity, your schedule."
    26	
    27	## The Workout — Method Overview
    28	Heading: "THE REDROOM WAY"
    29	Body: "Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Our method is designed to maximize calorie burn, build lean muscle, and keep your metabolism elevated for hours after class. Hustle and heart set us apart."
    30	
    31	## Floor vs. Treadmill Toggle
    32	Heading: "Start on the Floor or the Treadmill"
    33	**Floor:** "Dumbbells, resistance bands, and bodyweight movements target specific muscle groups each day. Our instructors guide every rep to ensure proper form and maximum results."
    34	**Treadmill:** "From power walks to all-out sprints, the treadmill portion is designed to torch calories and build cardiovascular endurance. Every speed and incline is coach-led — all levels welcome."
    35	
    36	## Weekly Class Schedule
    37	
    38	| Day | Muscle Group Focus |
    39	|---|---|
    40	| Monday | Chest & Back |
    41	| Tuesday | Full Body (Lower Focus) |
    42	| Wednesday | Arms & Abs |
    43	| Thursday | Arms & Abs |
    44	| Friday | Full Body (Upper Focus) |
    45	| Saturday | Full Body |
    46	
    47	## Studio Experience
    48	Heading: "Meet Us in the Red Room."
    49	Body: "Red lights. Loud music. Zero distractions. Our studios are purpose-built for performance — every detail from the sound system to the lighting is engineered to push you harder. This isn't a gym. This is the Red Room."
    50	CTA: "THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD — Don't Wait. Book Now to Get the Red Room Experience."
    51	
    52	## Free Trial CTA
    53	Heading: "JOIN US FOR A FREE 30 DAY TRIAL"
    54	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial"
    55	
    56	## Instructor Roster
    57	
    58	Instructors are displayed as a filterable card grid. Each card shows: instructor name, home studio, and a "Book a Class" link.
    59	
    60	**Filter by location:** All Locations · New York · Los Angeles · London · Miami · San Francisco
    61	
    62	Sample instructors:
    63	- **Dani Reyes** — New York
    64	- **Marcus Cole** — Los Angeles
    65	- **Priya Nair** — London
    66	- **Jordan Voss** — Miami
    67	- **Tessa Kim** — San Francisco
    68	- **Andre Williams** — New York
    69	- **Sofia Marquez** — Los Angeles
    70	- **Liam Chen** — London
    71	
    72	CTA: "Get Started Today" | "Book a Class"
    73	
    74	## RIDE FAQ Content
    75	
    76	| Question | Answer |
    77	|---|---|
    78	| What is RIDE x LIFT? | RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio. |
    79	| What should I wear? | Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required. |
    80	| Do I need cycling shoes? | No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer. |
    81	| How long is the class? | Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor. |
    82	| Is RIDE x LIFT good for beginners? | Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level. |
    83	| Where is RIDE x LIFT available? | RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations. |
    84	
    85	## Digital Platform Features
    86	
    87	Heading: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
    88	
    89	- **World Class Workouts On Your Time** — Access RedRoom's signature HIIT classes filmed with top instructors. Treadmill, floor, and full-body formats available on demand.
    90	- **Workouts That Push You to Your Limits** — Strength, cardio, abs, stretching, and more. New classes added weekly across multiple categories and difficulty levels.
    91	- **Unlimited Access** — One membership, unlimited streaming. No caps on how many classes you take per week.
    92	- **30 Day Free Trial** — Try the full digital library free for 30 days. Cancel anytime.
    93	- **Anytime, Anywhere** — Stream on your phone, tablet, laptop, or TV. Your Red Room, wherever you are.
    94	
    95	CTA: "Join the Fit Fam Today" | "Start Your Free Trial"
    96	
    97	## Lifestyle Carousel
    98	A swipeable image carousel showcasing the RedRoom lifestyle — studio action shots, community events, post-workout moments, and branded apparel. Navigable via left/right arrows or swipe gestures.
    99	
   100	## Newsletter Signup
   101	Heading: "Newsletter Form Signup"
   102	Body: "Stay in the know. Get workout tips, class updates, and exclusive offers delivered to your inbox."
   103	Fields: Email address
   104	CTA: "Subscribe"
   105	Validation: Email format check; confirmation message on success.
   106	
   107	## Footer Navigation
   108	**Explore:** The Workout · Instructors · RIDE FAQ · Digital Platform · Community Events
   109	**Company:** Our Studios · Global Expansion · Fuel Bar · Blog · Careers
   110	**Connect:** Shop · My Account · Download the App (iOS / Android)
   111	**Country Selector:** Dropdown with available regions (US, UK, Australia, Canada, etc.)
   112	
   113	## Global Navigation
   114	Primary nav items: The Workout · Instructors · RedRoom RIDE · RedRoom X (Digital) · The Community · Our Studios · First Timers
   115	Utility nav: Book Now · Buy Classes · Shop · My Account

     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

steps.message:
The RedRoom Fitness 5-page corporate website is complete and all files are in `/app/output/`. Here's a summary:

## Pages Built

| Page | File | Key Sections |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Home** | `index.html` | Hero, Community Promo, Two Ways, Studio Experience, Free Trial CTA, Lifestyle Carousel, Newsletter |
| **The Workout** | `the-workout.html` | Hero, Method Overview, Weekly Schedule Table, Floor/Treadmill Toggle, Studio Experience, CTA |
| **Instructors** | `instructors.html` | Hero, Location Filter Bar, Instructor Card Grid, CTA |
| **RIDE FAQ** | `ride-faq.html` | Hero, FAQ Accordion (single-open), Newsletter |
| **Digital Platform** | `digital-platform.html` | Hero, Features Overview, Workout Types, Unlimited Access, CTA |

## Interactions Implemented

- **Homepage Carousel** — Smooth slide transitions with prev/next buttons, dot indicators, and touch/swipe support
- **Floor/Treadmill Toggle** — Seamless content switch with active state styling and fade animation
- **Instructor Location Filter** — Dynamic grid filtering across all 5 cities (New York, Los Angeles, London, Miami, San Francisco) with animated transitions
- **FAQ Accordion** — Single-open behavior; clicking a question collapses all others
- **Newsletter Validation** — Inline email format validation with clear success/error feedback on every page
- **Country Selector** — Footer dropdown with 5 regions, closes on outside click

## Design System

- **Dark theme** with `#141414` background and `#FF0000` primary accent
- **Oswald** display font for headlines, **Inter** for body text
- Fully responsive with mobile hamburger menu
- Consistent sticky nav and footer across all pages
- All inter-page links use relative paths
